---
title: "Outside the workshop"
---

The [companion curriculum](../../companion/index.qmd) takes each model and each argument presented during the day further, in modules that each stand on their own.

- [Panel data](../../companion/panel-data.qmd) – the models fitted to the panel during the day, output by output.
- [Meta-analysis](../../companion/meta-analysis.qmd) – the results of the five analysts on a common scale.
- [Causal graphs and adjustment sets](../../companion/dags.qmd) – the graph drawn during the day, at a slower pace, and a graph for a question of your own.
- [Scale construction](../../companion/measurement.qmd) – the decisions about measurement that the menu opened.
- [The multiverse and its critics](../../companion/multiverse.qmd) – the debate, read against the curve of the claim.
- [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd) – how the panel was built from the survey files.
- [R on the country-year panel](../../companion/intro-r.qmd#sec-speccurve) – the specification curve of the case study read in R.
- [Reproducibility repositories](../../companion/repositories.qmd), then [Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html) on the AR4DS site – archiving and versioning the analysis that you declared.
